scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @garage/api && npm run build -w @garage/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test "**/*.test.ts" && npm run validate:seed
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
